summary: Ran requested P0 QuickPrint fixture round (backend + frontend). Fixture seeding script runs, template /use works, but fixture vehicle retrieval and vehicle-entry UI flow are blocked in this runtime.

critical.issue: Returns 500 (Internal Server Error) instead of vehicle JSON after running backend/seed_quickprint_fixture.py.
Returns 500 with Postgres error code 22P02: invalid input syntax for type uuid: 'fixture-quickprint-vehicle-001'.

minor.issue: Credentialed CORS preflight still responds with Access-Control-Allow-Origin='*' instead of explicit origin.

ui_bugs.issue: After login, navigating to /vehicles/fixture-quickprint-vehicle-001 lands on dashboard (/), so vehicle print trigger is absent.

integration_issues.flow: vehicle -> QuickPrint -> template sheet -> preview -> PDF/WhatsApp/Print on 390px
integration_issues.issue: Blocked because vehicle details route is not reachable for fixture vehicle in current runtime; could not execute end-to-end selector path.

issues: Primary task context is lost when route falls back to dashboard, preventing execution of requested QuickPrint acceptance path.

action_items: Align fixture IDs with active DB provider: runtime is DB_PROVIDER=supabase (UUID-typed vehicle_id), but current fixture uses non-UUID ids and seeds Mongo only.
For Supabase mode, either seed fixture rows into Supabase with valid UUIDs or add provider-aware fixture generation; then map those IDs into frontend test path.
Ensure GET /api/vehicles/{id} handles invalid ID format gracefully (404/422), not 500.

After backend vehicle retrieval is fixed, rerun 390px flow to validate Bottom Sheet selection, full-screen preview scroll/action bar, and selected template id parity across /use + PDF + WhatsApp + Print.
critical_code_review_comments: Root integration mismatch: backend/seed_quickprint_fixture.py writes only to Mongo (MONGO_URL/DB_NAME) while runtime DB_PROVIDER is supabase; this prevents fixture visibility in active APIs.
Supabase vehicle-visits query uses .eq('vehicle_id', <non-uuid>) against uuid column, producing 22P02 and bubbling as 500.
QuickPrintDialog has preview modal markup, but there is no reachable trigger path in this run because vehicle route entry fails first.
No MOCKED APIs were used in this run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fixture template endpoint works (/api/document-templates/fixture-quickprint-template-001/use = 200), but fixture vehicle GET and visits fail with 500 in supabase runtime. UI navigation to /vehicles/fixture-quickprint-vehicle-001 redirects to /, so vehicle-print-menu-button is absent.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: (1) Run python backend/seed_quickprint_fixture.py (success). (2) Login as مدير/123123. (3) Call GET /api/vehicles/fixture-quickprint-vehicle-001 -> 500. (4) Call GET /api/vehicles/fixture-quickprint-vehicle-001/visits -> 500 with 22P02 invalid uuid. (5) Open /vehicles/fixture-quickprint-vehicle-001 on 390px -> redirected to /. RCA: fixture uses non-UUID IDs and seeds Mongo collections, but runtime is DB_PROVIDER=supabase with UUID-typed vehicle references; vehicle endpoints/query path reject non-UUID values and UI cannot enter vehicle details. Mitigation: provider-aware fixture seeding to active datastore with UUID IDs (or provider switch), and defensive validation for invalid id format to return 4xx instead of 500.
